title: factory-tiers policy
description: Schema for .github/factory-tiers.json. Anything not listed in a tier is T2.

tests_command.description: Shell command factory-tests runs on the PR head. Use "true" for a repo with no tests.

code_owners.description: Logins whose APPROVED review clears T2 that CODEOWNERS cannot enforce. Teams are not supported.

selftest_globs.description: Files factory-tests runs with --selftest when they contain that flag outside a comment.

t2_new_file_globs.description: Paths that may be edited at a lower tier, but where a new file is T2.

t2_if_diff_contains.description: Literal strings that escalate to T2 when on a changed line, e.g. for skills touching gates.
